question: Bhagoriya is a well-known dance of the Bhils, a large tribe of the Jhabua district in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Madhya Pradesh.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhagoriya **is a well-known** dance** of the **Bhils,** a** large tribe **of the** Jhabua district **in **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• The dance is associated with a festival known as Bhagoria and a fair called **Bhagoriya Haat.**
 
• The** festival also has an agricultural significance **attached to it as it** **marks the end of the harvest season and is celebrated a week prior to Holi.
 
• The unwed boys and girls of the tribe prepare for this** fest that serves the purpose of a marriage bureau by establishing links between prospective brides and bridegrooms** leading to the nuptial union.
